name: Tubal Cain
source: Tubal Cain is one of the members of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying Seat II of the Black Round Table. Unlike most members of the Longinus Thirteen, Tubal Cain is a walking corpse with no apparent will of its own, puppeteered into combat by Riza Brenner through the use of her Ahnenerbe, Pallida Mors. It is the strongest asset in the hands of the Obsedian Round Table, only surpassed by the higher echelons of their organization.
